LESSON: SPELLING INSTRUCTION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING 4.1 Word and By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners are guided to 
Topic 4.2: Spelling instruction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Spelling instruction
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. spell words with short and long of letter, sound correspondences, and vowel sounds and consonant common letter patterns clusters 
2. use phonic knowledge to spell writing or unknown texts and provide and write familiar and correct spelling(spacing, punctuation, unfamiliar words and spelling) 166
3. use simple editing strategies to  Learners practice spelling sight words correct spelling in simple  Learners participate in spelling sentences challenge contest, individually, in pairs

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Spelling instruction

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Spelling instruction

Teach
• Focus skill: spell words with short and long of letter, sound correspondences, and vowel sounds and consonant common letter patterns clusters .
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Spelling instruction.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Spelling instruction
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
